infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Loop Me uses the camera only when you choose to photograph a message to check. The photo is read on this phone and never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Loop Me opens your photos only when you choose a screenshot to check. It is read on this phone and never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Loop Me can add a trusted family member from your contacts, so you can reach them in one tap. Your contacts stay on your phone.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Loop Me uses the microphone only when you tap ‘Speak it’ to say a message out loud. Nothing is uploaded.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Loop Me turns your speech into text on this phone when you tap ‘Speak it’, so the message can be checked. Nothing is uploaded.
